variant.title: Renban Lines Sudoku
variant.description: Digits on each purple line form a non-repeating consecutive set in any order.
rule.renban: Digits on each purple line are distinct and form a consecutive set in any order.
rule_guide.title: Renban Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Digits cannot repeat on a purple Renban line.
rule_guide.item_2: The digits on each line form a consecutive set, but may appear in any order.
